senses.gloss: (cmp. זמן, a. Syr. זבן) [to plan,] to bargain, buy.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 25:10">Targ. Gen. XXV, 10</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 30a">B. Bath. 30ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 30b:3">30ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>מפלניא זְבִינְתָּהּ דזַבְנָהּ מינך</he> I bought it of such a person who has bought it of thee.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 30b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>אִיזְבּוּן דינאי</he> I will buy what by law belongs to me (to avoid litigation); a. v. fr.

<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 25:31">Targ. Gen. XXV, 31</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 25:33">33</cite>; a. fr.—B. Bath. l. c. <he>זַבְּנָהּ ניהלי</he> sell it to me. Ib. 90ᵃ, a. e. (prov.) <he>זְבַן וזַבֵּין … איקרי</he> buy and sell and be called a merchant, i.e. will a man buy and sell without profit?—
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:6">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>מילי דזְבִינֵי וזַבּוּנֵי</he> Ag. hat-Torah (v. Rabb. D. S. a.—l. note 50; ed. <he>מילי דעלמא</he>) rules about buying and selling.

<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>כל מילי זבין וכ׳</he> as regards all things, sell and regret, except wine <he>דתְזַבֵּין ולא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דזבין</he>) which you must sell and never regret.
<cite ref="Gittin 47a:4">Gitt. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ נפשׁיה וכ׳</he> sold himself to &c.; a. fr.—Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ bot. <he>זבית ערסי</he> (read: <he>זֵבְּנִית</he>) I sold my bedstead.

senses.gloss: to be sold, to be bought; to sell one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 105:17">Targ. Ps. CV, 17</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 40b:7">B. Mets. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה מִזְדַּבֵּן לי</he> (Ms. M. <he>הוה זבנתיה</he>) it would have been saleable with me.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 69a:7">Kidd. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ואִיזְדַּבֵּן וכ׳</he> and get thyself sold as a Hebrew slave.
